blocking_reasons: No live OpenMetadata server is reachable in this environment: OPENMETADATA_URL, OPENMETADATA_AUTH_TOKEN, OPENMETADATA_PILOT_FQNS are absent from both the process environment and .env; docker-compose.yml does not run an OpenMetadata container. V2-P02 §33 pass criterion #1 ('live OpenMetadata authentication succeeds') cannot be met.

Consequently criteria 2, 3, 5-9, 13, 14 also cannot be exercised: server API compatibility, bounded pilot fetch, canonical FQN mapping under real payloads, column type fidelity, SQL identifier status, live nullability count, declared PK/FK mapping under real payloads, live snapshot parity, live authorization filtering.
not_a_project_defect_reason: This is an environment prerequisite. Every deterministic gate remains green: 547 passed / 2 skipped across unit+integration, ruff PASS, mypy PASS, 35/35 architecture guards including 10 V2-P01 OpenMetadata guards and 6 V2-P01R MG0-parity tests.

known_code_level_findings_to_address_bef.title: NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GAP
known_code_level_findings_to_address_bef.summary: CatalogColumn.is_nullable=None is materialized as ColumnContext.is_nullable=True, which then reaches the S0 solver prompt as 'nullable: True'. This is an UNKNOWN → FACTUAL TRUE conversion that violates Doc 04 §19. The OpenMetadata column mapper correctly preserves None at the canonical DTO layer; the loss happens at ColumnContext construction.
known_code_level_findings_to_address_bef.severity: MEDIUM (semantic fidelity risk for pilot columns lacking nullability declarations)
known_code_level_findings_to_address_bef.remediation_status: DEFERRED — V2-P02 §11 forbids preemptive fix. Options documented in results/v2_p02/live_mapping_manifest.json under code_level_gate_analysis.NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.remediation_options_documented_not_implemented. Requires a separate governance phase before enterprise LAB deployment can claim semantic fidelity for these columns.

known_code_level_findings_to_address_bef.title: SQL_IDENTIFIER_MAPPING_GAP possibility
known_code_level_findings_to_address_bef.summary: OpenMetadata mapper reads sql_identifier only from top-level raw.sqlIdentifier or raw.extension.sqlIdentifier. Real LAB metadata may not carry either field. When the mapper returns None, GroundingContextBuilder drops the table with a GroundingIssue('unresolved_sql_identifier'). This is fail-closed and safe, but may make legitimate pilot tables unusable.
known_code_level_findings_to_address_bef.severity: PILOT-DEPENDENT — becomes BLOCKING only if a required pilot table cannot be represented for a legitimate reason (a → adapter defect) or (b → catalog gap).
known_code_level_findings_to_address_bef.remediation_status: AWAITS LIVE INSPECTION — do not invent a fallback in V2-P02 (§10).

deterministic_findings_unchanged_from_v2: OpenMetadata client + provider: read-only, pagination-safe, cardinality-capped, secret-safe (repr redaction)
MG0 information boundary: unchanged (tags/glossary in retrieval scoring only)
path_to_unblock: 1. Operator provisions a LAB OpenMetadata instance with a bot service account (least privilege READ; no write scopes).
2. Operator selects 3-10 pilot tables per V2-P02 §4 (2 related, 1 declared FK, descriptions, multiple columns, optional view/tag/glossary) — NOT drawn from BIRD or P2 schemas.
3. Operator exports OPENMETADATA_URL, OPENMETADATA_AUTH_TOKEN, OPENMETADATA_PILOT_FQNS, METADATA_PROVIDER=openmetadata in the shell (never commit).

4. Re-run this phase. The live_smoke_manifest, pilot_metadata_quality_manifest, live_mapping_manifest, live_snapshot_parity_manifest, and live_authorization_boundary_manifest are then populated with real counts; L3_OPENMETADATA_LIVE_PATH is promoted from NOT_EXERCISED to PASS or FAIL according to observed evidence.

5. If NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GAP is DETECTED, choose a remediation option from live_mapping_manifest.NULLABILITY_SEMANTICS_GATE.remediation_options and land it in a separate governance phase before certifying semantic metadata fidelity.
readiness_note: The tracked deterministic evidence is production-ready for the OpenMetadata contract path. Live LAB pilot certification is the next required step and cannot be simulated.
